files.prompt_en: Use case: illustration-story. Create one production character sprite for a fantasy exploration adventure game. Maintenance captain Boro stands alone in a three-quarter front view. Broad shoulders, short iron-grey hair, a trimmed square beard, observant dark eyes and a stern weary expression. A faded olive work coat over a dark brown waistcoat and plain linen shirt, a simple leather belt, charcoal trousers and sturdy brown boots. Both hands are empty; one hand opens in a restrained negotiating gesture near the waist and the other rests naturally at his side. Full body from hair to boot soles, centered in a portrait canvas 1024 by 1536 with generous transparent margins. Hand-painted illustration with restrained textured brushwork, natural body proportions, clear facial features, softly modeled cloth and leather, soft even light and a crisp readable silhouette. The figure and clothing alone form the visible image, with clean transparent space immediately around the silhouette. The entire surrounding canvas is genuinely transparent.
files.prompt_ja: 用途は物語イラスト。幻想的な探索ゲーム用の人物立ち絵。整備隊長ボロが一人、少し斜め正面を向いて立つ。広い肩、短い鉄灰色の髪、角形に整えた短いひげ、注意深い暗色の瞳、厳しさと疲れのある表情。麻のシャツと焦茶色の胴着に色褪せたオリーブ色の作業上着、簡素な革ベルト、濃灰色のズボン、丈夫な茶色の靴。両手は空で、片手を腰の近くで控えめに交渉するように開き、もう一方は自然に下ろす。髪から靴底までの全身を縦長1024×1536の中央に置き、透明の余白を十分に取る。抑制の利いた筆の質感を持つ手描きのイラスト、自然な体の比率、明瞭な顔、柔らかな布と革の立体、均一で柔らかな光、明瞭な輪郭。人物と服だけが見え、輪郭のすぐ周囲から透明の空間。背景全体が完全に透明。
